name: tstack
description: Seven-skill chain that turns a rough product idea into a documented, milestone-sequenced, built project (Discovery → PRODUCT.md → technical docs → ROADMAP → plan/build loop, plus an iteration skill for adding features), an adoption on-ramp (tstack-ingest) that maps existing docs onto the chain for projects that didn't start in TStack, and three optional off-chain companions: tstack-design (UX spec + Claude Design prompts), tstack-status (read-only project inspector), and tstack-wrap (end-of-session doc-sweep that writes undocumented decisions to the right place).
